effort: Finish forceful presses and pulls in controlled positions while preserving quality for primary strength.

explosive.name: Band Chest Press — mid-range pause into fast finish
explosive.job: Primary force expression through the latter pressing range without losing rib or wrist position.
explosive.cue: Self-anchored permitted band across upper back; begin with elbows partly extended, hold 2 s, then finish the press quickly without snapping lockout. Return fully under control before setting the next start.
explosive.replacement: a full-range light band speed press if the partial start cannot be held comfortably
explosive.identity: band-chest-press parent; mid-range force-finish execution proposed
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Related to prior elastic presses; isolates a loaded mid-range-to-finish task rather than changing only band tension. It is explicitly not a new press family. A new traveling throw was rejected because strength quality is the emphasis.
explosive.key: Band Chest Press — mid-range pause into fast finish

explosive.name: Band Row — mid-range pause into fast finish
explosive.job: Express pulling force in the finish without substituting trunk extension.
explosive.cue: Permitted seated foot anchoring, begin elbows lightly bent; hold still 2 s, then draw toward lower ribs quickly. Return 2 s and reset; shoulders do not roll forward.
explosive.replacement: a full-range paused light band row if the partial start causes strain
explosive.identity: band-row parent; mid-range force-finish execution proposed
explosive.uniqueness_reason: A related row targeting completion from a held partial position. Different job from prior full-reach reversal; not counted as a new row because of tempo alone.
explosive.key: Band Row — mid-range pause into fast finish

explosive.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return
explosive.job: Express shoulder-driven backward force without elbow flexion carrying the movement.
explosive.cue: Very light dumbbells, stable hip hinge, elbows softly fixed; open arms only to a comfortable line with the torso, then lower 2 s. No shrug, trunk lift or ballistic weight release.
explosive.replacement: an unloaded same-path reverse fly with quick controlled opening if even light dumbbells disrupt alignment
explosive.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
explosive.uniqueness_reason: First rapid horizontal-abduction task with nearly fixed elbows. Unlike the rear-delt row, elbow flexion is deliberately removed; a face-pull speed drill was rejected to avoid a fast elastic line near the face.
explosive.key: Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return

explosive.name: Standing Wall Power Push-Off — return to upright
explosive.job: Keep a short fixed-contact pushing task with a clear balanced finish and no hand reception.
explosive.cue: Inspected wall, modest lean, feet fixed; push into brief hand separation and only to balanced upright, then reset slowly.
explosive.replacement: a non-flight fast incline push-up if wall structure or balance is unsuitable
explosive.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 9 repeat. A new hand-flight landing progression was rejected because it adds impact and skill demand before the strength-priority work; this retained task limits both.
explosive.key: Standing Wall Power Push-Off — return to upright

explosive.name: Medicine Ball Catch-Set Chest Pass — gentle coach feed
explosive.job: Connect controlled force acceptance to an organized forward pressing finish.
explosive.cue: Gentle chest-height feed; receive softly with both hands, hold 1 s at chest, then release forward on line. No immediate rebound chain.
explosive.replacement: a self-started stationary chest pass if receiving is unconfirmed; use a secured band press if the release area is unsuitable
explosive.identity: medicine-ball-chest-pass parent; same catch-set execution as Class 4
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 4 repeat at one set supplies direct projection with a predictable pause. A faster receive-return or step pass would add demand without serving the controlled-strength emphasis.
explosive.key: Medicine Ball Catch-Set Chest Pass — gentle coach feed

explosive.name: Band Biceps Curl — rapid neutral-grip pull
explosive.job: Keep a small elbow-flexion speed dose for the finish of the draw.
explosive.cue: Band secured under feet, elbows at ribs; quick flexion, lower 2 s, no hip swing or shoulder lift.
explosive.replacement: a light simultaneous dumbbell hammer curl with rapid controlled ascent if band fit is unsuitable
explosive.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 3 repeat reduced to three reps. A novel grip-transfer drill was rejected after the partial-range pulling work; this simple endpoint task limits setup and fatigue.
explosive.key: Band Biceps Curl — rapid neutral-grip pull

resilience.name: Scapular Push-Up — quadruped, dynamic
resilience.job: Lightly load controlled shoulder-blade travel for pushing support and force transfer.
resilience.cue: Hands and knees down; keep elbows straight. Settle chest 2 s, push away 2 s, hold 2 s without trunk sag.
resilience.replacement: a smaller controlled scapular range with more weight supported at knees

resilience.name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension — forearm supported
resilience.job: Lightly reinforce wrist alignment at the finish of loaded presses and pulls.
resilience.cue: Forearm supported, palm down; very light load, lift 1 s and lower 3 s without gripping maximally.
resilience.replacement: unloaded wrist extension if a light implement still causes compensation
resilience.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier

primary.name: Floor Press — two dumbbells, neutral grip
primary.job: Main horizontal pressing force with a reproducible floor-limited range.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, touch upper arms gently, pause 1 s, then press decisively; feet stay down. Coach supervises pickup/set-down.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor press through controlled comfortable range

primary.name: One-Arm Row — dumbbell, hand and knee on bench
primary.job: Load the arm-driven backward draw while support prevents torso rotation.
primary.cue: Draw elbow toward hip, hold 1 s, lower 2 s; stop before the shoulder rolls forward or the trunk turns.
primary.replacement: a thigh-supported dumbbell row with the same arm path if a bench does not fit

primary.name: Push-Up — controlled full repetition
primary.job: Load the press with free shoulder-blade movement and a steady trunk.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, push decisively, finish tall through shoulders for 1 s; no hand flight. Adjust leverage or band resistance to reach 2–3 RIR.
primary.replacement: a hands-elevated push-up on an inspected immovable support

primary.name: Dumbbell Rear-Delt Row — bilateral, hinged
primary.job: Strengthen the wider-elbow backward draw that controls the arm-open position.
primary.cue: Hold a still hinge; elbows about 60 degrees from torso, pull to upper ribs, hold 1 s, lower 2 s.
primary.replacement: a chest-supported version only on an inspected bench with adequate arm clearance

primary.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher — floor-supported
primary.job: Load elbow extension for the finish of a forceful press.
primary.cue: Neutral grips, upper arms near vertical; lower 2 s beside the ears, extend under control without shoulder swing.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor-supported elbow extension through comfortable range

primary.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl — simultaneous arms
primary.job: Load elbow flexors for finishing the backward draw without another shoulder-extension set.
primary.cue: Upper arms stay at ribs; lift 1 s, hold 1 s, lower 2 s, without hip swing or wrist collapse.
primary.replacement: a lighter neutral-grip curl without body movement

progression: Class 9 balanced strength doses are retained exactly: Floor Press 2 × 6, Row 2 × 6 per arm, and one set of eight for each remaining lift, totaling eight rounds and 68 task reps. The new drill emphasis is force completion, not an automatic strength-load increase. If actual prior full-range sets were controlled at the stated reserve with good recovery, consider the smallest practical increment on only one priority lift; otherwise hold or reduce. Do not shorten range to claim a heavier successful strength set. No class has established that an increment was earned.
audit_findings: Removed travel, overhead receiving and hand-flight landings; only three throws/catches remain, conditional on receiving control. Two related range-specific tasks, one new shoulder-driven task and three explicit low-demand repeats are documented. Reverse fly is one light rapid-force set, not an additional primary accessory. All six primary lifts remain challenging and separate from their explosive support; no double-counted reps or contrast-set promises.
next_job: Class 11 should refine the most relevant documented force limitation; with no athlete feedback, use an explicitly stated integration emphasis rather than inventing a weak side or performance deficit.
